title: Sindresorhus awesome: canonical meta-index of curated GitHub lists
summary: The canonical awesome-list meta-index maintained by Sindresorhus, linking hundreds of topic-specific curated GitHub resource lists. It defines community list-quality standards in awesome.md but does not implement any pipeline—only discovery across languages, front-end, tools, and CS topics.
question_it_answers: Where is the canonical index to find curated awesome GitHub lists when hunting a new domain?
